mismatches: The motor mount section (x=110 to 130) is not a widened flange as described; it appears to be the same thin profile as the rest of the arm.
The motor shaft clearance hole at (120, 0) and the four motor bolt holes are missing from the render.
The frame attachment holes at (6, +-6) are not visible in the render.
systemic: The design attempts to satisfy a stiffness constraint (I <= 1.0) and a strength constraint (sigma <= 30 MPa) that are mathematically contradictory for this geometry; the resulting part is too thin to support the motor load.
summary: The rendered part fails to include all required mounting holes and does not implement the widened motor mount flange described in the design document, while the underlying design concept is physically non-viable due to contradictory constraints.
